sname: 趣味・スポーツ・ジム
title: ジム・スポーツの口語表現

items.en: Hey, Jordan, the locker room's past the front desk.
items.jp: ねえジョーダン、更衣室は受付の先だよ。
items.speak: Hey, Jordan, the locker room's past the front desk.

items.en: I walked right past it twice. I'm off to a great start.
items.jp: 目の前を2回も通り過ぎたよ。最高のスタートだね。
items.speak: I walked right past it twice. I'm off to a great start.

items.en: Maya, can you show me how to adjust this machine?
items.jp: マヤ、このマシンの調整方法を教えてくれる？
items.speak: Maya, can you show me how to adjust this machine?

items.en: Sure. Let's start with the seat height.
items.jp: いいよ。まず座席の高さを調整しよう。
items.speak: Sure. Let's start with the seat height.

items.en: Hey, coach, am I doing this movement right?
items.jp: コーチ、この動きで合っていますか？
items.speak: Hey, coach, am I doing this movement right?

items.en: Bring the weight down a little and keep your back steady.
items.jp: 重さを少し下げて、背中を安定させて。
items.speak: Bring the weight down a little and keep your back steady.

items.en: I gotta catch my breath before the next set.
items.jp: 次のセットの前に息を整えなきゃ。
items.speak: I've got to catch my breath before the next set.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:必要を伝える

items.en: Take your time. There's no rush.
items.jp: ゆっくりでいいよ。急がなくて大丈夫。
items.speak: Take your time. There's no rush.

items.en: Hey, Jen, wanna grab a mat before class starts?
items.jp: ねえジェン、クラスが始まる前にマット取らない？
items.speak: Hey, Jen, want to grab a mat before class starts?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に誘う

items.en: Good idea. The ones by the wall are still free.
items.jp: いいね。壁際のはまだ空いてるよ。
items.speak: Good idea. The ones by the wall are still free.

items.en: Hey, folks, is this court open for pickup games?
items.jp: みなさん、このコートは自由参加の試合に使えますか？
items.speak: Hey, folks, is this court open for pickup games?

items.en: Yeah, we're starting in five minutes if you want in.
items.jp: うん、参加するならあと5分で始めるよ。
items.speak: Yeah, we're starting in five minutes if you want in.

items.en: I dunno if I'm good enough to join.
items.jp: 参加できるほど上手か分からないな。
items.speak: I don't know if I'm good enough to join.
items.note: 元の形: do not know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:迷いを話す

items.en: It's just for fun. Nobody's keeping stats.
items.jp: 遊びだからね。誰も記録なんてつけてないよ。
items.speak: It's just for fun. Nobody's keeping stats.

items.en: Hey, Sam, didja bring your water bottle?
items.jp: ねえサム、水筒持ってきた？
items.speak: Hey, Sam, did you bring your water bottle?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:持ち物を確認する

items.en: It's in the car. I'll grab it before we start.
items.jp: 車にあるよ。始める前に取ってくる。
items.speak: It's in the car. I'll grab it before we start.

items.en: Hey, Alex, the trail gets muddy after the bridge.
items.jp: ねえアレックス、橋の先は道がぬかるんでるよ。
items.speak: Hey, Alex, the trail gets muddy after the bridge.

items.en: Thanks for the heads-up. I'll watch my step.
items.jp: 教えてくれてありがとう。足元に気をつける。
items.speak: Thanks for the heads-up. I'll watch my step.

items.en: Hey, Chris, can you spot me on this last rep?
items.jp: ねえクリス、最後の1回を補助してくれる？
items.speak: Hey, Chris, can you spot me on this last rep?

items.en: I've got you. Keep the movement smooth.
items.jp: 補助するよ。動きをなめらかにね。
items.speak: I've got you. Keep the movement smooth.

items.en: Hey, Nina, the class starts at six, right?
items.jp: ねえニナ、クラスは6時開始だよね？
items.speak: Hey, Nina, the class starts at six, right?

items.en: Yeah, but we should get there early to sign in.
items.jp: うん。でも受付があるから早めに行こう。
items.speak: Yeah, but we should get there early to sign in.

items.en: I was gonna run outside, but it started pouring.
items.jp: 外を走るつもりだったけど、土砂降りになった。
items.speak: I was going to run outside, but it started pouring.
items.note: 元の形: was going to／聞こえ方: ワズガナ／使う場面:予定を説明する

items.en: The treadmill's open if you still want to run.
items.jp: まだ走りたいなら、トレッドミルが空いてるよ。
items.speak: The treadmill's open if you still want to run.

items.en: Hey, buddy, you good? You look a little pale.
items.jp: ねえ、大丈夫？少し顔色が悪いよ。
items.speak: Hey, buddy, are you good? You look a little pale.
items.note: 元の形: are you／聞こえ方: ユー／使う場面:体調を尋ねる

items.en: I'm okay. I just need to sit down and get some water.
items.jp: 大丈夫。座って水を飲みたいだけ。
items.speak: I'm okay. I just need to sit down and get some water.

items.en: Hey, team, the next match is on court two.
items.jp: みんな、次の試合はコート2だよ。
items.speak: Hey, team, the next match is on court two.

items.en: Got it. Let's warm up over there.
items.jp: 分かった。あそこで準備運動しよう。
items.speak: Got it. Let's warm up over there.

items.en: Hey, coach, could you show me that serve one more time?
items.jp: コーチ、あのサーブをもう一度見せてもらえますか？
items.speak: Hey, coach, could you show me that serve one more time?

items.en: Sure. Watch my wrist when I make contact.
items.jp: もちろん。ボールに当てる時の手首を見て。
items.speak: Sure. Watch my wrist when I make contact.

items.en: Hey, Jordan, let's cool down before we head out.
items.jp: ねえジョーダン、帰る前にクールダウンしよう。
items.speak: Hey, Jordan, let's cool down before we head out.

items.en: Good call. My legs are already complaining.
items.jp: そうしよう。もう脚が悲鳴を上げてる。
items.speak: Good call. My legs are already complaining.

items.en: Hey, Maya, didja save me a spot in the class?
items.jp: ねえマヤ、クラスの場所を取っておいてくれた？
items.speak: Hey, Maya, did you save me a spot in the class?
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:くだけた確認

items.en: I did. We're near the back, so no pressure.
items.jp: 取っておいたよ。後ろの方だから気楽にね。
items.speak: I did. We're near the back, so no pressure.

items.en: Hey, folks, anyone up for a short hike this weekend?
items.jp: みんな、今週末に軽いハイキングに行かない？
items.speak: Hey, folks, anyone up for a short hike this weekend?

items.en: I'm in, as long as we stop for snacks.
items.jp: おやつ休憩があるなら参加するよ。
items.speak: I'm in, as long as we stop for snacks.

items.en: Hey, Liz, the pool's quieter before work.
items.jp: ねえリズ、プールは出勤前の方が空いてるよ。
items.speak: Hey, Liz, the pool's quieter before work.

items.en: I know, but waking up that early feels illegal.
items.jp: 分かってるけど、そんな早起きは違法みたいに感じる。
items.speak: I know, but waking up that early feels illegal.

items.en: Hey, coach, should I stop if my knee starts hurting?
items.jp: コーチ、膝が痛み始めたらやめた方がいいですか？
items.speak: Hey, coach, should I stop if my knee starts hurting?

items.en: Yes. Stop and let me know; don't push through pain.
items.jp: はい。やめて知らせてください。痛みを我慢して続けないで。
items.speak: Yes. Stop and let me know; don't push through pain.

items.en: Hey, Sam, wanna split a smoothie after the workout?
items.jp: ねえサム、運動のあとスムージーを分けない？
items.speak: Hey, Sam, want to split a smoothie after the workout?
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:気軽に提案する

items.en: Sure. I could use something cold.
items.jp: いいね。冷たいものが飲みたい。
items.speak: Sure. I could use something cold.

items.en: Hey, Chris, gimme a second to tie my shoe.
items.jp: ねえクリス、靴ひもを結ぶからちょっと待って。
items.speak: Hey, Chris, give me a second to tie my shoe.
items.note: 元の形: give me／聞こえ方: ギミ／使う場面:少し待ってもらう

items.en: No rush. I'll fill my bottle while you do that.
items.jp: 急がなくていいよ。その間に水筒を満たしてくる。
items.speak: No rush. I'll fill my bottle while you do that.

items.en: Hey, Alex, I'm not sure I can finish the whole route.
items.jp: ねえアレックス、コースを全部回れるか自信がない。
items.speak: Hey, Alex, I'm not sure I can finish the whole route.

items.en: We can turn back whenever you want. No big deal.
items.jp: いつでも引き返せるよ。気にしなくていい。
items.speak: We can turn back whenever you want. No big deal.

items.en: Hey, team, nice work today. Same time next week?
items.jp: みんな、今日はよく頑張ったね。来週も同じ時間？
items.speak: Hey, team, nice work today. Same time next week?

items.en: Works for me. I'll bring the extra balls.
items.jp: 私は大丈夫。予備のボールを持ってくるよ。
items.speak: Works for me. I'll bring the extra balls.

items.en: Hey, Jordan, c'mon, one more lap and then we're done.
items.jp: ねえジョーダン、ほら、あと1周で終わりだよ。
items.speak: Hey, Jordan, come on, one more lap and then we're done.
items.note: 元の形: come on／聞こえ方: カモン／使う場面:励まして促す

items.en: All right, but you're buying the post-run coffee.
items.jp: 分かった。でも走った後のコーヒーはおごってね。
items.speak: All right, but you're buying the post-run coffee.
